integrity: Analytic proof and standalone finite checker are included. The checker does not certify infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: No exact entropy claim above one half; polynomial language count is an upper bound and not sharp. The endpoint value is taken from Reyes, not newly established. Historical full-text access to Becker–Baraviera (2023) was unavailable.
title: A golden-mean entropy plateau with a sharp half-density jump in frequency shifts
